title: Bivariate random-effects meta-analysis of diagnostic accuracy (Reitsma)
summary: Joint pooling of logit sensitivity and logit specificity across studies with their between-study correlation, by REML.
pinned_defaults: mada::reitsma (bivariate normal on logit sensitivity and logit false positive rate, REML); specificity = 1 - FPR.
No zero cells in the fixture, so no continuity correction.
_python_not_applicable: Python's standard stack has no bivariate random-effects meta-analysis. The entry is R only; the control file refits the same model with metafor::rma.mv (struct = 'UN') and requires agreement to 1e-5, and recovery is measured by running r.R on the seeds.
_correlation: With 20 studies the between-study correlation is poorly estimated (-0.02 here against a true -0.4); report it with that caution.
